name: Long context eval v1
description: Runs all 100 items of eval-longctx-v1 at temperature 0 and reports accuracy overall, by category and by difficulty. Pinned together with the dataset: a change to either means a new -v2 id.

eval.notes: Materialise each row's meta.haystack with datasets/haystack-v1/build.py and send PREAMBLE + document + prompt. Report accuracy per meta.target_tokens as well as overall; items above the served context length are failures with category context-overflow.

notes: accuracy and avg_latency_ms live in the result's `scores` block, not in `metrics`; success_rate is the share of requests that completed at all and is independent of whether the answers were right.
